ViewData.name: ViewData
ViewData.description:
Table structure used for [`render.RenderView`](https://wiki.facepunch.com/gmod/render.RenderView).

Unless stated otherwise, the default values for all these keys would be inherited from the engine's CViewSetup and do not have static representations.

fields.name: origin
fields.description: The view's original position. Defaults to the current view's origin

fields.name: angles
fields.description: The view's angles. Defaults to the current view's angles

fields.name: aspect
fields.description: Defaults to width divided by height. Has a deprecated alias `aspectratio`.

fields.name: aspectratio
fields.description:
The deprecated alias of `aspect`. Defaults to width divided by height.

**Deprecated**: Use `aspect` instead!

fields.name: x
fields.description: The x position of the viewport to render in

fields.name: y
fields.description: The y position of the viewport to render in

fields.name: w
fields.description: The width of the viewport to render in. Defaults to the current viewport's width

fields.name: h
fields.description: The height of the viewport to render in. Defaults to the current viewport's height

fields.name: drawhud
fields.description: Draw the HUD and call the hud painting related hooks

fields.name: drawmonitors
fields.description: Draw monitors

fields.name: drawviewmodel
fields.description: The weapon's viewmodel

fields.name: drawviewer
fields.description: Whether to force draw the local player or not.

fields.name: viewmodelfov
fields.description: The viewmodel's FOV. Defaults to the current viewmodel FOV

fields.name: fov
fields.description: The main view's FOV. Defaults to the current view's FOV

fields.name: ortho
fields.description:
If set, renders the view orthogonally. A table with these keys:
* left
* right
* top
* bottom

fields.name: ortholeft
fields.description:
Coordinate for the left clipping plane. Requires `ortho` to be set to `true`.

**Deprecated**: Use `ortho` table instead!

fields.name: orthoright
fields.description:
Coordinate for the right clipping plane. Requires `ortho` to be set to `true`.

**Deprecated**: Use `ortho` table instead!

fields.name: orthotop
fields.description:
Coordinate for the top clipping plane. Requires `ortho` to be set to `true`.

**Deprecated**: Use `ortho` table instead!

fields.name: orthobottom
fields.description:
Coordinate for the bottom clipping plane. Requires `ortho` to be set to `true`.

**Deprecated**: Use `ortho` table instead!

fields.name: znear
fields.description: The distance of the view's origin to the near clipping plane. Defaults to the current view's near clipping distance

fields.name: zfar
fields.description: The distance of the view's origin to the far clipping plane. Defaults to the current view's far clipping distance

fields.name: znearviewmodel
fields.description: The distance of the view's origin to the near clipping plane for the viewmodel. Defaults to the viewmodel's current near clipping distance

fields.name: zfarviewmodel
fields.description: The distance of the view's origin to the far clipping plane for the viewmodel. Defaults to the viewmodel's current far clipping distance

fields.name: dopostprocess
fields.description: Currently works identically to the "bloomtone" option (it also overrides it if you set this to false).

fields.name: bloomtone
fields.description: Disables default engine bloom and pauses the "brightness changes" on HDR maps.

fields.name: viewid
fields.description: This is identifying which logical part of the scene an entity is being redered in, see [`Enums/VIEW`](https://wiki.facepunch.com/gmod/Enums/VIEW).

fields.name: offcenter
fields.description:
This allows you to "zoom in" on a part of the screen - for example, the top-left quarter of the screen. This is similar to how [poster splits the screen](https://garry.blog/poster-screenshots/) into separate renders.

It's a table with 4 keys, controlling what portion of the screen to draw:
* left - where the left edge starts. Natural value is 0.
* right - where the right edge ends. Natural value is equal to w (the width of the viewport).
* top - where the `bottom` edge starts. Natural value is 0.
* bottom - where the `top` edge ends. Natural value is equal to h (the height of the viewport).

Note that top and bottom are reversed.

Values outside the viewport are allowed, but not recommended - instead you should increase the view FOV.

fields.name: viewid
fields.description: The current view id. See [`Enums/VIEW`](https://wiki.facepunch.com/gmod/Enums/VIEW).

fields.name: zfar

fields.name: znearviewmodel
fields.description: The distance of the view's origin to the near clipping plane for the viewmodel

fields.name: zfarviewmodel

fields.name: subrect
fields.description: Whether `m_bRenderToSubrectOfLargerScreen` if set for this view.

fields.name: offcenter
fields.description:
It's a table with 4 keys, controlling what portion of the screen to draw:
* left - where the left edge starts. Natural value is 0.
* right - where the right edge ends. Natural value is equal to w (the width of the viewport).
* top - where the `bottom` edge starts. Natural value is 0.
* bottom - where the `top` edge ends. Natural value is equal to h (the height of the viewport).

Note that top and bottom are reversed.

This will not be present if offscreen rendering is not enabled for this view.

See [`Structures/ViewData`](https://wiki.facepunch.com/gmod/Structures/ViewData) for more info.
